risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and well quantified, with clear year-over-year explanations and reconciliation of non-GAAP measures. Key risks relate to customer mix and margin pressure, restructuring charges, self-insurance estimates, impairment judgments, and supplier incentive assumptions. Overall tone is modestly positive, though several standard accounting-estimate caveats limit certainty.
